trips.destination: South America — research: Argentina (BA + Patagonia) | Peru (Lima + Sacred Valley + Machu Picchu) | Ecuador/Galápagos

breakdown.primary_recommendation: Peru only (Lima + Sacred Valley + Machu Picchu)
breakdown.galapagos_note: Budget-breaking — $9,000–14,000+ for 2 on mid-range cruise. Not viable at $10k alongside other destinations.

trips.summary: Research session completed June 2026. Verdict: 3-country combination (Argentina + Peru + Ecuador) is not feasible in 2 weeks — transit days consume the trip; violates Sarah's depth preference. Galápagos alone nearly consumes full $10k budget for 2. PRIMARY RECOMMENDATION: Peru only — Lima (2-3 nights, Barranco neighborhood, Sarah's food priority fully met via Surquillo Market + world-class restaurants) + Sacred Valley luxury lodge (4-5 nights, Tambo del Inka or Sol y Luna) + Machu Picchu 1 day (6am early slot to minimize crowds). April = sweet spot timing (shoulder season, lush green, fewer crowds). Budget comfortable at $4,050–7,650, leaves meaningful headroom. SECONDARY: Argentina BA + Patagonia — more adventure-forward, strong romance factor in Buenos Aires, Patagonia luxury lodges work for both profiles, April weather in Patagonia is variable/risky. Galápagos flagged as ideal standalone trip at $12-14k budget. Key open question: does budget flex to ~$13k? (unlocks Peru + Galápagos combination).

Honeymoon research option. Tanzania calving season Serengeti (March–April) + Ngorongoro Big Five crater + Zanzibar (Stone Town food immersion + east coast beach). Best East Africa timing. Zanzibar pairs logistically (1hr bush flight) and is budget-friendly. Madagascar deferred to dedicated 2028/2029 trip. Rwanda gorilla trek also deferred ($1,500/person permit alone). Budget achievable at $8,200–9,500 mid estimate with hot air balloon upgrade headroom ($1,200). Key camp tier: mid-range private concession ($200–300/pp/night all-inclusive). Key Zanzibar insight: Stone Town is one of Africa's great food cities — Sarah's #1 food priority fully met.

trips.destination: Vietnam (Hue → Quy Nhon via Vietage → Con Dao)
trips.summary: Honeymoon research option. Centrepiece is The Vietage by Anantara luxury rail carriage (12 passengers, Da Nang → Quy Nhon, ~$350–420pp, 6 hrs, 3-course meal + free-flow drinks + massage). Recommended itinerary: Hue (4 nights, imperial culture + royal food, Phong Nha day trip) → Vietage train (Da Nang to Quy Nhon) → Anantara Quy Nhon Villas (4 nights, private pool villa, Ky Co Beach) → Con Dao Island (4 nights, snorkeling, near-zero crowds — Six Senses splurge or Con Dao Resort on-budget). Total estimate: $8,200–$9,500 comfortable. On budget if Con Dao Resort used; over budget if Six Senses. Halong Bay and Hoi An Old Town flagged as tourist-saturated — avoid or minimize.

trips.destination: Europe — Option A (Mediterranean Coast) vs Option B (Danube Cruise)
trips.summary: Europe honeymoon research. Top 3 Mediterranean options: A1 Montenegro (Kotor Bay + Budva, $2,010 flights, dramatic fjord bay, very low crowds Mar-Apr, strong food scene, Adriatic adventure for Nir); A2 Istria/Slovenia (Rovinj + Piran, $1,627 flights — cheapest, best food match for Sarah with truffle hunts + wild asparagus, depth-friendly 2-stop, $5,227 total base); A3 Greek Islands Milos + Folegandros ($1,721 flights, no cruise ships, anti-Santorini energy, catamaran/cave beaches, some ferry risk in March). Option B Danube Cruise: Prague sentimental value is strong for both; AmaWaterways/Emerald are best operators; avg passenger age 55-70 — honeymoon couple will be 20+ years younger than median; NO nightlife; ship food not authentic local; AmaWaterways 7n = $6,400-10,000 total two pax all-in; Emerald budget tier = $6,500-7,500 total with flights. RECOMMENDATION: A2 Istria/Slovenia is strongest overall profile match. A1 Montenegro is best for pure romance + adventure. Danube cruise has sentimental appeal but demographic and nightlife gaps for Nir are significant.

Honeymoon trip. NZ covers Rotorua (Māori culture), Taupo/Tongariro (Alpine Crossing), Queenstown (adventure base, Milford Sound), Kaikōura (wildlife en route). Fiji: Mamanuca Islands confirmed. Likuliku sold out through 2028 — ruled out. Leading Fiji candidates: Lomani (top value pick), Tokoriki (best food/service, premium), Tropica (aesthetics + culture), Matamanoa (isolation + best reef). Outside Mamanucas: Marriott Momi Bay (overwater, mainland, no boat). Flying from Chicago ORD. Leading itinerary: fly into AKL, drive north NI, domestic flight to QZN, end in Fiji. ACCOMMODATION RESEARCHED (2026-06-06): Rotorua — Koura Lodge ($280-380, recommended), On The Point ($530-700, premium), Solitaire Lodge ($1100-1700, splurge). Taupo/Tongariro — Tongariro Crossing Lodge ($180-280, recommended), The Park Hotel Ruapehu ($120-200), Chateau Tongariro ($170-280). Queenstown — Kamana Lakehouse ($200-350, recommended), QT Queenstown ($280-420 w/ balcony), Hotel St Moritz ($200-350), Rosewood Matakauri ($1000-1500, splurge). Wanaka 1-night option: Lime Tree Lodge ($220-300). Kaikōura — Hapuku Lodge treehouse ($500-700 all-inclusive, standout), Bay Cottages ($100-170, budget), or skip overnight (lunch stop only). Easter 2027: Good Fri Mar 28 — avoid booking South Island accommodation for that long weekend without pre-booking.
